main_text.l: quæ inundatura erant Ecclesiam? annon illa commutarunt Pseudoepiscopi illorū, cum aquis quas Draco ex ore suo proiecit, ut Dei hæreditatem absorbeant, & cum blasphemijs bestiæ quas adversus Deum & Sanctos qui in cœlis sunt effundit? Talis tamen est maxima pars ejus congregationis, quæ Christum Salvatorem profitetur, in quā & reliqua religionis membra vel emortua vel morientia observemus, ut videatur, quanto jure hi vocem suam extollant, qui gloriam Christi imminui in terris conqueruntur, eamque locis ad illud commodis reservari postulant. Vide quomodo Venerabile Corporis Dominici Sacramentum, turpi Idololatria polluant, & Sanguinem Christi de quo dixit ut omnes eum biberent, simplicibus ejus ovibus eripiant. Vide quomodo Sacrilegi Paparum Sacrifici, ne quid veri honoris Christus in suâ Ecclesiâ haberet, histrionicè expressam prætiosam Domini mortem, & tragicè deploratam, momento persona mutata Indulgentijs Papalibus, Monachorum meritis, proprijs hominum operibus & satisfactionibus, votivis peregrinationibus, alijsque id genus commentis, in medium adductis obliterent, ac tanquam parum sufficientem ad ex-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Pseudoepiscopi" and "illorū" are clear enough, but the word after "Sacramentum" is rendered "Sacramentum" with a faint mark, and the first word of "Sacrifici" reads "Sacrifici,ne" as printed with a comma. Running head "AD INDOS." copied as printed. The page ends mid-word "ad ex-" which is a hyphenated break carried to the next page. Some letters in the upper lines are faded but readable. The printed page number reads 269 (the scan shows "26ʒ" in old form, copied here as 269).
